task.description: Design and write integration tests for ISS-203. Write tests/specs/ISS-203.md and tests/integration/iss203_idempotency_keys_test.zig. Required test cases (all real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL): (1) single transition emitted events carry correct deterministic keys; (2) replay dedup - run same transition twice, assert zero duplicate event rows; (3) client key passthrough - trigger event with user-supplied key stored as-is unchanged; (4) different-instance isolation - same transition on two different instances produces different keys; (5) ordinal uniqueness - N emitted events produce N distinct keys. All fixtures per-test UUIDs. No mocks. No error.SkipZigTest on MUST cases.
acceptance_criteria: No mocks, stubs, or in-memory fakes
No error.SkipZigTest on MUST test cases

result.summary: Wrote tests/specs/ISS-203.md (5 test cases) and tests/integration/iss203_idempotency_keys_test.zig covering all 5 ISS-203 MUST requirements: deterministic key format, replay dedup via ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, client key passthrough, different-instance isolation, and ordinal uniqueness. All tests use real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL, per-test UUIDs, no mocks or stubs, no error.SkipZigTest.
